purpose: The payment examples. PaymentService is a remote payment gateway called over REST (examples/rest/payment.js), so it has no Java class; ReceiptService is a Java service that issues the receipt for a paid order.

services.description: Authorises a card payment at a remote payment gateway. Payment n is for an amount derived from n unless the token carries one.
services.returns: A payment result with the payment, amount and status. Routes on "paid" or "declined". A gateway that is unavailable, or slower than the caller waits, fails the call.

services.description: Issues the receipt for a paid order, quoting the order (from the token's data) and the payment (from paymentResult).
services.returns: The receipt: the order, customer, payment, amount and currency. Routes on "issued".
